title: RL Training Resilience Framework

collapse_modes.name: Reward Hacking Escalation
collapse_modes.description: Model exploits reward loopholes; reward up but quality down
collapse_modes.warning_threshold: cheat_rate>5% OR reward UP but exec_success DOWN over 20 steps

collapse_modes.name: KL Divergence Explosion
collapse_modes.description: Policy drifts too far from reference; KL penalty insufficient
collapse_modes.critical_threshold: kl>0.30 OR entropy<0.1x_initial OR kl monotonic increase 30 steps

collapse_modes.name: Policy Entropy Collapse
collapse_modes.description: Policy becomes deterministic; GRPO advantage=0; stuck in local optimum

collapse_modes.name: Loss Spike / NaN
collapse_modes.description: Gradient explosion or numerical instability; NaN propagates

collapse_modes.name: Reward Distribution Drift
collapse_modes.description: Reward mean shifts without quality improvement; or reward_std->0
collapse_modes.warning_threshold: reward_mean shifts>2sigma in 50 steps OR reward_std->0
collapse_modes.critical_threshold: reward_std<0.01 for 30 steps OR shift>3sigma in 30 steps

collapse_modes.name: Gradient Stagnation
collapse_modes.description: Gradients vanish; model stops learning; LR too low or init too strong
collapse_modes.warning_threshold: grad_norm<0.01 for 50 steps OR reward_delta<0.001 for 100 steps

recovery_protocols.success_criteria: No NaN for 50 steps, loss within 2x rolling mean

actions: Consider warm restart if near end

post_resume_verification: 1. Run 5 eval rollouts - verify reward matches pre-collapse
5. If any fail: DO NOT resume

monitoring_dashboard.visualization: Matplotlib offline post-run (no live dashboard to avoid GPU contention)
monitoring_dashboard.alerting: CPU-only watchdog reads metrics JSON, evaluates thresholds, writes alerts log

alert_watchdog.action: write alerts log + touch HALT file if FATAL

key_findings: F1: Full FT ckpt=23.8GB (model 7.8+opt 15.6); LoRA=0.47GB — 50x smaller
F2: Peak storage Full FT=335GB=0.017% NFS — storage NOT a bottleneck
F3: 6 collapse modes: C1 reward hacking, C2 KL explosion, C3 entropy collapse, C4 loss NaN, C5 reward drift, C6 gradient stagnation
F4: All 5 collapse types detected in simulation within 1-30 steps; 0 false positives on healthy baseline
F5: FATAL(C4)=immediate halt+rollback; CRITICAL(C1/C2)=rollback; WARNING(C3/C5/C6)=in-flight adjustment
F6: Resume overhead=11-22min (ckpt load+SGLang restart+Ray reinit+verification); 7 pre+5 post checks
F7: 18 monitoring metrics (7 training+5 RL-specific+6 system); CPU-only watchdog, no GPU contention
F8: LoRA enables aggressive checkpointing (every 10 steps=4.7GB/h) — recommended for smoke test
recommendations: R1: save_interval=50 main, 5 smoke (already in script)
R2: Create baize_posttrain_resilience_callback.py as verl callback
R3: Create baize_posttrain_alert_watchdog.py as CPU background process
R4: Create baize_posttrain_rollback.sh for auto rollback
R5: Pre-allocate ckpt dir on NFS
R6: Smoke test: LoRA mode for frequent checkpointing
R8: best_reward saves model-only (7.8GB) to minimize permanent storage
